data.why: The real METABRIC_RNA_Mutation.csv requires a Kaggle login, so a small synthetic cohort (30 patients) with the same column names/types (clinical fields, ER/PR/HER2 status, grade, survival months, event) lets the Home and Survival Analysis pages render; it includes a censored-early case, a missing mutation_count value, and a tumor-size outlier.

goals: View cohort-level KPIs (patient count, event rate, median survival, model ROC-AUC) on the Home page
Compare Kaplan-Meier survival curves and log-rank p-values across clinical subgroups (ER, PR, HER2, grade, chemotherapy, hormone therapy)
Enter a hypothetical patient's clinical profile and biomarkers to get a 5-year mortality probability from the pre-trained Random Forest
Compare a predicted patient's risk against the cohort's ~22% baseline 5-year mortality rate via the gauge chart
Inspect which clinical/genomic features drive the model's predictions via the global feature-importance chart

review.summary: The tree follows the demonstrator's real arc: cohort overview, then Kaplan-Meier comparison by subgroup, then a what-if 5-year risk estimate against the ~22% baseline. Most of the cited screens show what their nodes claim. Two of the ten I opened do not, the data source is labelled 'built-in' though it is a synthetic 30-patient cohort, and the model-reliability panel is missing, so it should be fixed before filing.
